name: pi-desktop-site
description: Public product site and documentation for Pi Desktop

scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-docs.mjs && node scripts/sync-brand.mjs && astro dev
scripts.check: node scripts/sync-docs.mjs && node scripts/sync-brand.mjs && astro sync && astro check && vitest run --exclude "tests/build/**"
scripts.build: node scripts/sync-docs.mjs && node scripts/sync-brand.mjs && astro build && node scripts/check-links.mjs dist && vitest run tests/build
